sections.content: Links can do more than navigate: fragment links (#section) jump within a page, mailto: opens email, tel: dials on mobile, and download attributes save files.
Link text should describe the destination ("Read the guide", not "click here") — screen readers announce links out of context.
Key points: absolute vs relative paths, rel="noopener" for target="_blank" security, and visited/focus states matter for usability.
